args.stdin: WITH store AS (SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE store_name = 'PowerTool Salzburg Elisabeth-Vorstadt'), employee AS (SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_display_name, e.employee_email, e.record_path FROM employee_accounts e WHERE e.employee_display_name = 'Marcel Bergmann' AND e.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)), role AS (SELECT r.role_code FROM employee_role_assignments r WHERE r.employee_id = (SELECT employee_id FROM employee)) SELECT (SELECT store_id FROM store) as store_id, (SELECT employee_id FROM employee) as employee_id, (SELECT employee_email FROM employee) as employee_email, (SELECT record_path FROM employee) as employee_record_path, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role WHERE role_code LIKE '%manager%') > 0 as is_manager;
